# Matthew Hale

**Who.** Partnerships lead at NEST, a hardware incubator in Kendall Square (12 companies a cohort, two cohorts a year). MIT '19 mechanical engineering; three years at a robotics startup.

**How we met.** He wrote first, eight days ago, after the post on explaining AI without the hype. Andrés Villarreal says he is "the one who actually answers mail".

**What he wants.** Someone who can explain AI to his founders without the hype. His founders build physical products and get sold AI every week.

**What I want.** One founder with a product where AI changes the margin — and to know whether NEST pays for workshops.

## Next
Today 14:15, 1 Broadway. Dana Whitlock (Ferrous Robotics) may stop by.
